successive_repair_composition_invariant.definition: For stage vector x_i whose least false stage is s_i and whose deliberately planted next false stage is s_{i+1}, a valid repair R_i changes exactly s_i from false to true, leaves every stage earlier than s_i true, leaves every stage strictly between s_i and s_{i+1} true, and leaves s_{i+1} false. Therefore first_fail(R_i(x_i)) = s_{i+1}.
successive_repair_composition_invariant.composition_rule: For any prefix of valid repairs R_0..R_{k-1}, induction on k gives first_fail(x_k)=s_k. Each step exposes exactly the pre-planted successor and cannot jump over it because s_{i+1} remains false while all earlier stages are true.
successive_repair_composition_invariant.no_skip_corollary: If an observed transition under a purported single repair jumps from s_i to a stage later than the planted s_{i+1}, then at least one metamorphic precondition is false: the repair changed more than s_i, the planted successor was not preserved false, or an intervening stage was not fixed as specified. Such a transition is rejected as invalid evidence rather than counted as a successful repair.
successive_repair_composition_invariant.pre_cas_preservation: The terminal planted stage in this composed chain is G6, which is strictly before CAS1/CAS2, so every valid composed case remains mutation_path_reachable=false.

proof.base_case: C0 has first_fail=L0. Repairing only L0 while preserving planted L1/D2=false yields first_fail=L1/D2.
proof.inductive_step: Assume after i valid repairs first_fail=s_i. R_i changes only s_i, preserves all earlier and intervening stages true, and preserves s_{i+1}=false; therefore the least false stage after R_i is exactly s_{i+1}.
proof.conclusion: Across C0-C8, no valid single-repair composition can skip a planted successor. A skip is a contract-violation signal, not a stronger success result.
proof.scope_limit: The proof is structural for the frozen stage abstraction. It does not establish that any concrete byte-level implementation enforces the same repair footprint or that a Chat-native external-effect primitive exists.
